title: SFBond 실버폭스 #070 · 바디페인팅 · 목 링 벽 고리 + 발목 쇠공 · 체형 super hourglass · Polynesian · early 50s · 헤어 sleek wet-look hair slicked straight back
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Polynesian woman, a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 50s silver fox goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, silver-white sleek wet-look hair slicked straight back — full body Islamic geometric star-tile pattern bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold formations — a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, BLAZING GOLD and VIVID CRIMSON bands following every deep curve of her body, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a calm, distant gaze. Restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the flagstones beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long stiletto holographic nails gold crimson tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
